description: Downloadable native executables and model files that IRIS depends on at runtime. Binaries are NOT committed to git; run the downloader to fetch them locally into ./bin.

dependencies.name: Android Platform Tools (adb)
dependencies.reason: Wireless/USB phone connection, mirroring, telemetry and remote input in the Mobile tab.

dependencies.name: scrcpy (screen mirroring)
dependencies.reason: Low-latency phone screen streaming and control shown in the Mobile tab.

dependencies.name: FFmpeg
dependencies.reason: Audio capture/transcoding for the WebRTC voice pipeline and screen/gallery processing.

dependencies.name: Vosk Small English Model
dependencies.reason: Offline wake-word ("Hey, IRIS") and local speech recognition via vosk-koffi.
